items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: What's her name, Jo Diamond? You know you were in and out of the studios so much, it's hard to remember all the names.

ctx.x: What did you work after that?

Oh, after that, let's see... I have to get a list of all the shows that I was involved in then. What's her name, Jo Diamond? You know you were in and out of the studios so much, it's hard to remember all the names. The things that stick in my mind most are later, like Hawaii Five-O, and then I went on staff at NBC and I did Let's Make A Deal or something like that. I was just on call for whatever they did. Later... I guess I'm getting ahead of myself, but it's okay. Later The Danny Kaye Show; I did that for four…
So what kinds of things did you do? Because some people who get staff positions like that get bogged down in studio work, and don't get out and do the other things.
